title: feat(types): object-kanban declares grouping as the spec's GroupingConfig, by reference (objectui#11216)
body:
Fixes #11216

Clause-②: yes

## What this changes

`object-kanban` now declares `grouping` on both faces of `@object-ui/types`, as `@objectstack/spec`'s `GroupingConfigSchema`, by reference. The spec's `object-kanban` row has typed the key that way since 17.6.0, which `main` installs. `ObjectKanban` reads `grouping.fields[0].field` as the fallback for `swimlaneField`.

Before this change the arm did not declare the key, so the faces and the spec gave three answers for one document:

| `grouping` value | spec row | strict face (before, now) | tolerant face (before, now) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{ fields: [{ field: 'owner' }] }` | accept | refused by name, **accept** | kept, accept (kept as authored) |
| padded `{ fields: [{ field: '  x  ' }] }` | refuse | refused by name, refused at `grouping.fields.0.field` (`custom`) | kept, **refused** |
| bare string `'owner'` | refuse | refused by name, refused at `grouping` (`invalid_type`) | kept, **refused** |
| `{ fields: [] }` | refuse | refused by name, refused at `grouping.fields` (`too_small`) | kept, **refused** |
| undeclared key on the block or on an entry | refuse | refused by name at the node, refused by name inside the block | kept, **refused** |

- **Zod mirror** (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`): `grouping: stripImportedDefaults(SpecGroupingConfigSchema).optional()`, which is how `ObjectGridSchema.grouping` spells it. The strict face is derived from the same declaration, so one member covers both runtime faces. The spec's `order` and `collapsed` defaults are not added to a parsed document. The comment that left the key to this card is gone.
- **TypeScript twin** (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`): `grouping?: GroupingConfig`. A type-level row pins it equal to `SpecObjectKanbanProps['grouping']` and to `GroupingConfig | undefined`.
- **The renderer is unchanged.** `ObjectKanban.tsx` still reads `swimlaneField || grouping.fields[0].field`.

## Descriptions that called the spec row `z.unknown()`

Each one now describes the typed row: it fixes the block's SHAPE, but not which position this board reads.

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/structuredKeysAreDeclaredAndHonoured-8313.test.ts` (header).
- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/ObjectKanban.structuredMembersReachTheirSinks-8313.test.tsx` (header).
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, the `MEMBER_PINS` entry `object-kanban.grouping` (its `pins` text only; no booked difference moved).

⚠️ **The card's location for the first description was wrong for `main` at `ab18797`.** The card names "the kanban registration description (`packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`)". That file has no `unknown()` wording: a search for `unknown` finds only two unrelated code lines, while `swimlaneField` (the control) is found. The `grouping` input description there says only `fields[0].field` is read, which is still true, so it is unchanged. The wording the card meant is in the three places above. The console entry is the registration's member-pin description, and the claim listed it as conditional surface.

## Also in this change

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/grouping-field-padded-refused-7347.test.ts`: its census of arms that declare `grouping` goes red when a new arm declares it, so `object-kanban` gets a `DECLARING` row. The padded-name refusal is now pinned on all four of the arm's faces.
- Docs: a `grouping` row in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx` and in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`. The schema reference paragraph that said "`grouping` is still undeclared" is corrected.
- `.changeset/11216-kanban-grouping-typed.md`: `@object-ui/types` minor.

- **Red first, before the fix.** The new pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-kanban-grouping-typed-11216.test.ts` ran on the base tree: `Tests  28 failed | 12 passed (40)`. The strict face refused the well-formed config with `unrecognized_keys` at the node, and the tolerant faces kept every shape the spec refuses. (That run used an earlier version of the pin's issue helper. The ablation below is the measurement on the committed pin.)
- After the fix: `Test Files  1 passed (1)` and `Tests  40 passed (40)`.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/`: `Test Files  65 passed (65)`, `Tests  442 passed (442)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: `Tests  255 passed (255)`.
- Consumer radius: 11 test files in app-shell, plugin-view, plugin-list and schema-catalog that feed `object-kanban` documents or grouping through the validators, run without editing any of them: `Test Files  11 passed (11)`, `Tests  176 passed (176)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban type-check`: exit 0. Both script names were echoed. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both edited `packages/types` pins.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-kanban^...' build`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The pending `.changeset/11355-small-p1-sites.md` says "`grouping`, the read's fallback, is still undeclared". It is a dated record of that change, and `check-changeset-overwrite` refuses edits to existing changesets, so it is left as is. Both entries will publish in the same release, this one after it.
- `ObjectKanban.filterMembersReachTheWire-8176.test.tsx` (header) still calls `filter`'s spec row `z.unknown().optional()`. On the installed release, that row is an array of closed `{ field, operator, value }` objects, and `sort` is not on the `object-kanban` row. The console `MEMBER_PINS` entry `object-kanban.filter` repeats the same claim. Out of this card's scope and not changed here. No one is set to pick it up.
